While SuttaCentral lists no curated parallels for the poem in non-Pali corpora [SuttaCentral], automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus reveals eighteen matching passages shared across four Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus identifies no cross-language matches in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora meeting the threshold score [DharmaNexus].
